Informed continuation after shared Xor, GHZ, QFT and coherent QPE experiments.
The author read the retained Qualtran AddK/Equals translations and their pinned
originals. No external framework was run and no upstream file was downloaded.
The exact model settings were not recorded; this is not a controlled benchmark.

Write one all-ones control, recursive increment, repeated-constant addition and
restoring equality source before extending the development compiler. Existing
source calls accept one quantum owner; the desired source needs multiple
arguments and coherent control of an explicitly grouped product of owners.
This is not an implicit conversion to one Q<tuple> owner. All operations must
lower to already checked phase-fixed control, X, structural and composition
rules. Generic source preservation and production integration remain open.

Follow the user's 2026-09-30 small-system validation scope. Use widths zero to
three locally, both target values, wraparound, entangled reference columns and
valid-but-wrong arithmetic mutations. Do not generate/check maximum sizes.
Zero-width ownership is a local boundary extension, not an upstream API claim.
